content.short: LiQ is a DeFi-native liquid staking protocol for MNT tokens on Mantle, enabling stakers to use liquid representations across the DeFi ecosystem.
content.description: LiQ is a liquid staking protocol native to the Mantle Network, allowing MNT token holders to stake their assets and receive liquid staking tokens representing their staked positions. These liquid tokens can be used across Mantle's DeFi ecosystem  in lending, trading, or yield strategies  while the underlying MNT continues to earn staking rewards. LiQ bridges the gap between staking security and DeFi capital efficiency for Mantle participants.
